scope: Exact abstract qualified identities, revision/Field/known-meaning guards, immutable lookup extensionality and atomic refusal.
limits: Core validation, JSON snapshot/tuple encoding, Unicode/parser behavior, source-map/permutation construction and TypeScript implementation are assumed, not proved.
Known core definitions do not establish literal/function applicability, domain equivalence, ontology validity or native permissions.
Matching caller revision labels does not authenticate the original source; positive unauthenticated model is deliberately SAT.
